practice.title: Guided implementation: Testing Types
steps: Write down what Testing Types does and when you would reach for it, before writing code.
Implement the smallest working example of Testing Types using the platform SDK, an emulator, and a device or simulator.
Add one edge case, watch it fail or pass, then document what you learned.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on Testing Types for Mobile Testing. Finish it by checking that it runs without errors and handles its empty and error states.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply Testing Types
projects.description: Apply Testing Types for Mobile Testing and produce a runnable app screen implementing the target behavior. Then check that it runs without errors and handles its empty and error states.
projects.goal: Demonstrate working command of Testing Types by producing a runnable app screen implementing the target behavior and verifying that it runs without errors and handles its empty and error states.
requirements: A runnable app screen implementing the target behavior that genuinely applies Testing Types for Mobile Testing.
Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: it runs without errors and handles its empty and error states.
outcomes: Working project source plus a screen recording.
A short written explanation of Testing Types you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.
